description:
Make audio louder or quieter by a fixed number of dB, or normalize its loudness.

Works on the first audio stream of audio and video files. A video is re-encoded.
Disabled unless the sandbox allows writing.

gain_db.description: Change the volume by this many decibels. +6 is about twice as loud.

input.description: Source file, relative to the sandbox root.

normalize.description: Normalize loudness to -16 LUFS instead of applying a fixed gain. The audio is resampled to 48 kHz. Do not combine with gain_db.

output.description: File to create. Its extension selects the format. Audio: mp3, m4a, aac, ogg, opus, flac, wav. Video: mp4, mov, mkv, webm, gif.

overwrite.description: Replace the output if it already exists.

name: adjust_volume

description:
Change the playback speed of an audio or video file without changing the pitch.

The result is shorter for factor > 1 and longer for factor < 1. Disabled unless the
sandbox allows writing.

factor.description: Playback speed. 2 is twice as fast, 0.5 is half speed. Pitch is kept.

input.description: Source file, relative to the sandbox root.

output.description: File to create. Its extension selects the format. Audio: mp3, m4a, aac, ogg, opus, flac, wav. Video: mp4, mov, mkv, webm, gif.

overwrite.description: Replace the output if it already exists.

name: change_speed

description:
Convert an audio or video file to another format, chosen by the output extension.

Converting a video to an audio format keeps only the audio. Video formats keep the
first video and the first audio stream. Disabled unless the sandbox allows writing.

audio_bitrate_kbps.description: Audio bit rate in kbit/s. Ignored for lossless formats (flac, wav).

crf.description: Video quality, lower is better and larger. Default 23, webm 32.

input.description: Source file, relative to the sandbox root.

output.description: File to create. Its extension selects the format. Audio: mp3, m4a, aac, ogg, opus, flac, wav. Video: mp4, mov, mkv, webm, gif.

overwrite.description: Replace the output if it already exists.

name: convert_media

description: Extract the files of a zip or tar archive. Empty directories are not recreated.

archive.description: Zip or tar archive, relative to the sandbox root.

dest.description: Directory to extract into. Created if missing.

name: extract_archive

description:
Extract the first audio stream of a video (or audio) file into an audio file.

Fails with invalid_input when the input has no audio stream. Disabled unless the
sandbox allows writing.

audio_bitrate_kbps.description: Audio bit rate in kbit/s. Ignored for lossless formats (flac, wav).

input.description: Source file, relative to the sandbox root.

output.description: Audio file to create. Its extension selects the format: mp3, m4a, aac, ogg, opus, flac, wav.

overwrite.description: Replace the output if it already exists.

name: extract_audio

description: Return the kind, size, modification time and guessed MIME type of a path.

path.description: File or directory, relative to the sandbox root.

name: file_info

description: Find regular files below a directory that match a glob pattern, sorted by path.

max_results.description: Maximum matches to return. Defaults to the configured limit.

path.description: Directory to search from, relative to the root.

name: find_files

description: List the files and directories directly inside a directory.

include_hidden.description: Include names starting with a dot.

max_entries.description: Maximum entries to return. Defaults to the configured limit.

path.description: Directory to list, relative to the sandbox root.

name: list_dir

description:
Describe an audio or video file: container, duration, bit rate and every stream.

Streams list codec, resolution and frame rate (video) or sample rate and channels
(audio). Use it before converting or trimming to see what a file contains.

path.description: Audio or video file, relative to the sandbox root.

name: media_info

description: Read a text file. Large files are cut at max_bytes and flagged as truncated.

encoding.description: Text encoding. Detected automatically when omitted.

max_bytes.description: Maximum bytes to read. Defaults to the configured limit.

path.description: File to read, relative to the sandbox root.

name: read_text

description:
Write a copy of a video without its audio track.

Fails with invalid_input when the input has no audio stream. Disabled unless the
sandbox allows writing.

input.description: Source file, relative to the sandbox root.

output.description: Video to create. Its extension selects the format: mp4, mov, mkv, webm, gif.

overwrite.description: Replace the output if it already exists.

name: remove_audio

description:
Scale a video to a new size and/or frame rate, keeping the aspect ratio.

With only width or only height the other side follows the aspect ratio. With both, the
video is scaled to fit inside that box and is never stretched. Disabled unless the
sandbox allows writing.

crf.description: Video quality, lower is better and larger.

input.description: Source file, relative to the sandbox root.

output.description: Video to create. Its extension selects the format: mp4, mov, mkv, webm, gif.

overwrite.description: Replace the output if it already exists.

name: resize_video

description:
Save a single frame of a video as a png, jpg or webp image.

Disabled unless the sandbox allows writing.

at_s.description: Time of the frame in seconds. Default: the middle of the video.

input.description: Source file, relative to the sandbox root.

output.description: Image to create. Its extension selects the format: png, jpg, webp.

overwrite.description: Replace the output if it already exists.

width.description: Scale the image to this width in pixels, keeping the aspect ratio.

name: thumbnail

description:
Keep only a time range of an audio or video file.

Give start_s and either end_s or duration_s. Without both of those the cut runs to
the end of the input. Disabled unless the sandbox allows writing.

duration_s.description: Length of the cut in seconds. Do not combine with end_s.

end_s.description: Where the cut ends, in seconds from the start of the input. Do not combine with duration_s.

input.description: Source file, relative to the sandbox root.

output.description: File to create. Its extension selects the format. Audio: mp3, m4a, aac, ogg, opus, flac, wav. Video: mp4, mov, mkv, webm, gif.

overwrite.description: Replace the output if it already exists.

start_s.description: Where the cut begins, in seconds.

stream_copy.description: Copy the streams instead of re-encoding. Much faster and lossless, but the cut snaps to keyframes and the output must use the same format as the input.

name: trim_media

description: Write text to a file. Disabled unless the operator enabled writing for the sandbox.

overwrite.description: Replace the file if it already exists.

path.description: File to write, relative to the sandbox root.

text.description: Content to write, encoded as UTF-8.

name: write_text
